text:
Predicates:
Born(x, y) ::: x was born in year y.
KnownAs(x, y) ::: x is known as y.
FootballPlayer(x) ::: x is a football player.
LoanedTo(x, y) ::: x was loaned out to y.
PlaysFor(x, y) ::: x plays for y.
Club(x) ::: x is a football club.
Premises:
Born(ailton, year1995) ∧ KnownAs(ailton, ailton) ∧ FootballPlayer(ailton) ∧ LoanedTo(ailton, braga) ∧ PlaysFor(ailton, nautico) ∧ FootballPlayer(ailton) ∧ PlaysFor(ailton, nautico) ::: Ailton Silva, born in 1995, is commonly known as Ailton. Ailton is a football player who was loaned out to Braga. Ailton Silva is a Brazillian footballer who plays for Nautico.
Club(nautico) ∧ Club(braga) ∧ Club(fluminense) ::: Nautico is a football club along with Braga. Fluminense is a football club.
Conclusion:
¬Club(ailton) ::: Ailton Silva foes not play for a football club.
